title: Google DeepMind opens Genie 4, a world model you can steer while it runs
friendlyTitle: Google DeepMind has opened Genie 4, a world you can change while it runs
summary: DeepMind announced Genie 4 on 27 October as a research preview for trusted testers. The model generates a scene and its sound together, including music, ambient noise, and dialogue. A person can change the weather, the camera, or the objects with a text prompt while the simulation is running. Gemini Omni anchors how the world looks. Other Gemini models help keep the scene coherent.
friendlySummary: DeepMind announced Genie 4 on 27 October. For now it is a research preview for a small group of trusted testers. The model builds a scene and its sound at the same time, including music, background noise, and spoken dialogue. You can change the weather, the camera, or the objects by typing, while the scene is still running. Gemini Omni handles how the world looks. Other Gemini models help keep the scene consistent.
whyItMatters: It is not a consumer product yet. DeepMind says the next step is Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie, plus early-access partners on the Gemini API and Google AI Studio. The uses it names are training environments for robots and agents, and new interactive experiences. It also says details and objects can still drift, and that accurate audio, legible text, and long-term consistency are unfinished.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You cannot buy this yet.
